pos.personaBrief: Pass-and-move with the ball as a relay baton and keeping the ball to wear the opponent down; he said Liverpool were not about aesthetics but effective, and he disliked unpredictability.

pro.personaBrief: Simple short passing to the nearest red shirt, patient build-up after 1973, but no long-ball emphasis.

est.personaBrief: Predictable, well-drilled roles (3-3-4, orthodox wingers) with tight five-a-side style short combinations.

lar.personaBrief: Orthodox wingers Callaghan and Thompson kept wide, with the right wing a priority; he saw no reason to use them differently.

blo.personaBrief: Work twice as hard to win the ball back and fitness-based pressure, but also get behind the ball and contain; no documented high-line press.

mar.personaBrief: Revie dossier shows Yeats sticking like glue to the centre-forward and full-backs close to wingers, implying individual marking.

pla.personaBrief: Predictable own way of playing regardless of opponent, imposing the Liverpool way on arrivals; belittled opponents rather than studying them.

res.personaBrief: Winning, bastion of invincibility; accepted a 2-0 away loss pragmatically and contained slender leads; fans pay to see wins.

sis.personaBrief: System of exhaustion and recovery, plan understood by all, everyone works; no individual expected to win alone.

jog.personaBrief: Fitness and work rate central, big, brave, strong players, hard stoppers; technique basic and simple.

bas.personaBrief: Nursery essential and phased out older players, but also bought young signings like St John and Yeats and educated new signings slowly in reserves.

lid.personaBrief: Players' man who fights for them, but he picks the team alone, keeps distance with senior players, no favouritism.
